plan.name: bench-d-setback
plan.description: R1.5 class D, setback and recovery: a hostile encounter in an otherwise calm life, followed by a long quiet period. Horizons are experiment settings chosen against the affect half-lives (unease 1200, valence 6000, control 12000 ticks): short about one valence half-life, medium two control half-lives, long six. Development: may be inspected freely; never used to evaluate a model finally.
